selected_route: Some Couples Have No Responsible Adult - Dance Floor Version
why_it_wins: It replaces the stale one-quirky-one-patient engine with mutual participation.
The hook is instantly taggable: viewers can send it as 'this is us' without needing private context.
The visual system is cinematic and desi: a public function, movement, fabric, eye-line, hands, and a near-embarrassment turned into choreography.
Zuv's role is active without becoming perfect-husband: he joins the bit instead of rescuing from above.
Aachu remains expressive and lovable; the scene celebrates her energy instead of mocking it.
open_risks: Must not become 'woman embarrasses herself, man saves her.'
Must avoid using the snag as a wardrobe-malfunction joke.
Must make her pull him into the bit so the final emotion is mutual conspiracy.
Must keep text small and scene-native.
